statusDetail: Cloudflare managed challenge returned HTTP 403 and did not clear in raw-CDP Chrome. No origin page or user flow was reachable, so this is a retained partial run and not a quality score.

page.notes: Only Cloudflare’s “Just a moment…” verification interstitial was observed. WordPress-like favicon paths appeared in challenge traffic, but the origin implementation was not inspected.
